title: 第906章 姜夜的鱼儿找来了第905章 就这
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
两日后。
凌霄仙舟依旧悬停于万魔天城上空。
这座古老仙舟通体流转着璀璨神辉，仿佛一座自九天而来的神山，镇压在这片魔气翻涌的天地之间。
与下方那座历经无数岁月的魔城相比，凌霄仙舟显得格外醒目。
万魔天城终年笼罩于无尽魔云之下，天穹暗沉，日月无光，哪怕是一些修为稍弱的修士，踏入其中都会感受到一股压抑至极的气息。
可偏偏。
那艘仙舟之上，金色光辉流转。
犹如黑暗深渊之中，突然降临的一座神塔。
这一日。
万魔天城内，诸多魔界势力开始陆续抵达。
各方魔族强者降临，有魔皇一脉的随从，有古老魔宗的传人，也有一些隐世多年的准帝人物。
毕竟。
万魔宴会乃是魔界难得的盛事。
凌霄仙舟最前端。
姜夜静静盘坐。
金色神辉环绕周身，宛若一尊年轻神王。
他的双眸微闭。
看似是在闭目养神。
可实际上。
他的神念早已覆盖整座万魔天城。

一道道细微至极的金色光点，悄然散落于虚空各处。
这些光点并不耀眼。甚至没有任何力量波动。
哪怕是仙王从旁经过，都未必能够察觉。
但在姜夜眼中。
整个万魔天城，都已经化作了一幅清晰无比的画卷。
任何一丝异常，都无法逃过他的感知。
这正是他这些日子完善后的光之溯源秘法。
不再局限于追踪某一道气息。
而是将自身大道化作无数光之印记，融入天地之间。
光所至。
皆为他的感知范围。
“虎玄。”
姜夜眸光微动。
对于这个最近同样出现在万魔天城的气运之子，他并没有过多关注。
虎玄这些时日一直表现得十分低调，并没有主动制造什么麻烦。
这种情况下。
姜夜自然懒得提前动手。
content_en:
Two days later.
Lingxiao Immortal Boat is still hovering over Ten Thousand Demons Celestial City.
This ancient immortal boat is filled with radiant light, like a sacred mountain from the Nine Heavens, suppressing the surging demonic energy between heaven and earth.
Compared with the demon city below that has gone through countless years, the Lingxiao Immortal Boat is particularly eye-catching.
The City of Ten Thousand Demons is shrouded under endless demonic clouds all year round. The sky is dark and the sun and moon lack light. Even some monks with weaker cultivation levels will feel an extremely oppressive atmosphere when they step into it.
Can be biased.
On the immortal boat, golden light circulated.
It was like a divine tower suddenly descending from the dark abyss.
This day.
In the Ten Thousand Demonic Heavenly City, many demonic forces began to arrive one after another.
Powerful demons from all sides arrived, including followers of the Demon Emperor's lineage, descendants of the ancient Demon Sect, and some quasi-emperors who had been hidden from the world for many years.
after all.
The Banquet of Ten Thousand Demons is a rare event in the demon world.
The front end of Lingxiao Immortal Boat.
Jiang Ye sat cross-legged quietly.
Golden divine light surrounds the whole body, like a young divine king.
His eyes were slightly closed.
It seems that he is concentrating with his eyes closed.
But actually.
His divine thoughts have already covered the entire Demon City.
A series of extremely subtle golden light spots were quietly scattered throughout the void.
These spots of light are not dazzling. Not even any power fluctuations.
Even if the Immortal King passes by, he may not be able to notice it.
But in Jiang Ye's eyes.
The entire Ten Thousand Demons Heavenly City has turned into an extremely clear picture.
No trace of abnormality could escape his perception.
This is the secret method of tracing the source of light that he has perfected these days.
No longer limited to tracking a certain breath.
Instead, he transformed his own avenue into countless light marks and blended them into the world.
Wherever the light goes.
They are all within his range of perception.
"Hu Xuan."
Jiang Ye's eyes moved slightly.
He didn't pay too much attention to this son of fate who also appeared in Ten Thousand Demons Heavenly City recently.
Hu Xuan has been keeping a very low profile these days and has not taken the initiative to cause any trouble.
In this case.
Jiang Ye was naturally too lazy to take action in advance.
